Items: a pancake or crumpet-like round (possibly with cheese or butter), a strawberry yogurt cup (Browns dairy, probably around 100-150 g), and water.

The pancake looks about 10 cm across, roughly 60-70 g, with a slice of cheese or butter underneath. That is about 180 kcal including the cheese or butter.

The yogurt is a small cup, probably 100-120 g, at about 100 kcal. The second photo shows the cup empty with the lid inside, so all of it was eaten.

The plate is clean, so the whole pancake was eaten.

Water has no calories, so I'm leaving it out.

Total mass is about 65 g of pancake and 110 g of yogurt, which is roughly 175 g. Total energy is about 180 + 100 = 280 kcal.
